description: Removes a logo, channel watermark, date stamp or burnt-in text that stays in the same place, with ffmpeg on this machine. Give the areas in video pixels, or omit them and a static watermark is found by comparing frames from across the video. smooth fills each area from its surroundings (ffmpeg delogo), blur hides it under a blur. Writes an MP4; the sound is kept. For an AI fill that rebuilds texture, use app.ionelul.com/video-watermark-remover. Needs ffmpeg installed.

method.description: smooth (default) fills the area, blur hides it

regions.description: Areas to clean, in pixels of the upright video (default: found automatically)

name: video_remove_watermark
title: Remove a watermark from a video
